# klms 0.2.3

## Correctness

- Korean KLMS pages no longer fail with `UPSTREAM_SHAPE_CHANGED` when listing
  assignments or quizzes, or when reading grade and attendance reports. Report
  and coursework headers, week labels, empty-page messages, and absolute or
  relative dates are recognized in Korean as well as English. Compact grade
  reports without the Percentage and Contribution columns also work.
- Calendar events use the card heading as their title instead of the submission
  button text, and read structural timestamps first, falling back to English or
  Korean date text in Asia/Seoul. Deadlines that were previously left out of
  `klms today` and `klms upcoming` now appear. Resource URLs keep their numeric
  ID and drop action parameters. A visible date that cannot be parsed remains an
  explicit error rather than being silently dropped.
- Scripts, templates, and hidden text are ignored when checking for empty
  pages, and grade and attendance reports require enough matching columns to
  avoid picking an unrelated table. Thanks to @AidenGeunGeun for the fix.

Other text locales are not verified; an unrecognized dated event fails agenda
generation rather than being omitted.

No command grammar, JSON envelope version, dependency, or SQLite migration
changes.
